name: @pipeworx/mcp-fjc-judges

tools.name: fjc_judge_lookup
tools.description: Look up a US federal (Article III) judge by name in the Federal Judicial Center biographical directory — every Supreme Court justice, court of appeals and district court judge since 1789. Returns each appointment: court, title, appointing president and party, ABA rating, nomination, hearing, confirmation and commission dates, Senate vote, chief-judge and senior-status dates, and when and how service ended; plus birth, death, education and professional career. Answers "who appointed Judge X", "when was X confirmed", "is X still serving", "where did X go to law school".

name.description: Judge name, full or partial, e.g. "Ketanji Brown Jackson", "Sotomayor", "Learned Hand".

limit.description: Max matches returned in full (default 5, max 25).

tools.name: fjc_judges_by_court
tools.description: List US federal judges who sat on a given federal court — e.g. the Supreme Court, the Ninth Circuit, the Southern District of New York — from the Federal Judicial Center directory. Filter to judges currently in active service, currently serving (active or senior status), or everyone since the court was created. Returns name, title, appointing president and party, commission date and service status per judge. Answers "who are the active judges on the Fifth Circuit", "how many judges has SDNY had".

court.description: Court name or fragment, e.g. "Supreme Court", "Ninth Circuit", "Southern District of New York", "District of Columbia Circuit".

status.description: "active" = active service only (default); "serving" = active or senior status; "all" = every judge ever on the court.

limit.description: Max judges returned (default 50, max 200). Total is always reported.

tools.name: fjc_judges_by_president
tools.description: List the Article III federal judges appointed by a US president, from the Federal Judicial Center directory, with counts by court level (Supreme Court, courts of appeals, district courts). Returns each appointee's name, court, commission date and current service status. Answers "how many judges did Biden appoint", "which Supreme Court justices did Reagan appoint", "Trump appellate appointees".

president.description: President name or surname, e.g. "Joseph R. Biden", "Biden", "Obama", "George W. Bush".

court_type.description: Optional: restrict to one court level.

limit.description: Max appointments listed (default 50, max 200). Totals cover all of them.

tools.name: fjc_seat_succession
tools.description: Trace who held a US federal judgeship (Article III seat) before and after a judge, from the Federal Judicial Center biographical directory. Give a judge name (or an FJC Seat ID) and get the whole chain of holders of that seat in order, each with appointing president, commission date and how service ended, plus the named predecessor and successor of the judge asked about. Answers "who did Judge X replace", "who succeeded Justice Y", "who has held this seat".

name.description: Judge name, full or partial, e.g. "John G. Roberts", "Millett". Add court if the surname is common.

seat_id.description: FJC Seat ID of any holder of the seat, e.g. "CADC0607" (returned by fjc_judge_lookup). Alternative to name.

court.description: Optional court fragment selecting which of a judge's appointments to trace, e.g. "District of Columbia Circuit".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-fjc-judges forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the fjc-judges pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
